payload.comment_body:
## Build Update

Evidence-only run: the assigned clean head already contains the complete committed capability, and no task comment or retained canonical failure requires another source edit.

- Added repository-owned Makefile and make.cmd adapters for worktree setup plus typecheck, test, build, and fail-fast quality targets.
- Routed the existing Pages build through make quality without changing artifact upload, permissions, or deployment ordering, and documented both platform entry points in README.
- Retained baseline evidence: npm ci, typecheck, 69 active test files / 701 active tests, and the three-entry Vite production build passed before adapter implementation.
- Current static evidence: make -n quality expands typecheck, test, then build; missing FAKTORIAL_WORKTREE_PATH and an unsupported Windows target both fail nonzero with actionable messages; git diff --check main...HEAD passes.
- No Faktorial Runtime Notes or material skill invocation applied. No UI or generated assets were changed.
- Canonical adapter execution is intentionally handed to Faktorial's run-quality verifier.

pull_request_description.delivered_outcome: A repository-owned cross-platform build and verification contract now prepares Faktorial worktrees and gives contributors and CI one canonical quality entry point.
pull_request_description.implementation_approach: A GNU Makefile and native Windows make.cmd expose matching worktree, typecheck, test, build, and quality targets. Worktree setup uses deterministic npm ci in the explicitly supplied, quoted destination. The Pages workflow calls make quality after dependency installation, and README documents both platform forms.
pull_request_description.solution_rationale: Small native adapters reuse the project's existing npm scripts, preserve their behavior and exit statuses, and satisfy Faktorial's platform-specific target discovery without adding dependencies or another build framework.
pull_request_description.tradeoffs_and_alternatives: The adapters intentionally orchestrate the existing scripts instead of duplicating package-script logic. GNU Make uses recursive targets and Windows uses batch labels with call, which keeps failure propagation explicit at the cost of maintaining two small platform-native files. Dependency upgrades and broader pipeline changes were excluded.
pull_request_description.architectural_decisions:
The repository verification process now has one cross-platform contract shared by local workers and Pages CI.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  W[Fresh worktree] --> I[npm ci]
  C[Contributor or Pages CI] --> Q[quality]
  Q --> T[Typecheck]
  T --> V[Vitest]
  V --> B[Production build]
```
pull_request_description.verification: The pre-change clean-head baseline passed npm ci, TypeScript checking, 69 active Vitest files with 701 active tests, and all three Vite production entries. Current static checks confirm quality ordering, actionable nonzero Windows guard failures, and a clean git diff check. Faktorial run-quality is requested for canonical post-commit execution.
